title: Seldon State-Space Vector
description: Schema for the delivery system state vector and control inputs.

open_agent_prs.description: Total number of agent-generated PRs currently open.

draft_agent_prs.description: Number of agent-generated PRs in draft state.

review_queue_depth.description: Number of PRs awaiting human or adversarial review.

active_jules_tasks.description: Number of active assignments for worker 'jules'.

active_claude_tasks.description: Number of active assignments for worker 'claude'.

blocked_issues.description: Number of issues with stale markers or failed checks.

stale_markers.description: Count of stale delegation or review markers.

failed_checks.description: Count of recent CI or governance check failures.

pause_new_feature_fanout.description: Stops assigning new feature work to agents.

request_gemini_read_only_review.description: Requests adversarial review without write permissions.
